subject: Renewal: EU residency + APAC warm-standby (resiliency pathway)
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@novalabs.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: ops@novalabs.com
Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + EU residency + APAC warm-standby

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note from NovaLabs — our initial contract with Redwood is up for renewal in July and our security/compliance team has asked that we formalize data residency for EU workloads and add an APAC warm-standby for DR and peak seasons.

Goals:
- Move production traffic for EEA customers to an EU-resident instance (data at rest and primary compute in EU).
- Keep an APAC warm-standby (replicated, encrypted, cold until failover) for regional failover and to handle scheduled marketing spikes.
- Confirm log retention and audit traceability for 24 months.
- Review any price changes for a 24-month term vs. current 12-month.

Can you send an estimated cost delta and an updated SOW/term sheet? If possible, we’d like a walkthrough with engineering next week to confirm key rotation/KMS mapping and failover playbook.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Head of Ops, NovaLabs
maya@novalabs.com

--

1) Internal scoping (we’ll draft a target SOW + capacity uplift).
2) Engineering walkthrough (30–45m) to confirm KMS, network allowlists, failover SLA and audit log delivery.
3) Pricing + term sheet for 12 vs. 24 month options and an upsell path for committed throughput.

Suggested times for a technical call: Tue 26 Jun 10:00–11:00 CEST or Wed 27 Jun 09:00–10:00 SGT. Which works for you?

I’ve attached a short summary of the requirements we’ll include in the SOW and our standard residency checklist.

Best,

Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2028 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal + EU residency + APAC warm-standby — pricing & SOW ask

Team — forwarding NovaLabs renewal request. TL;DR: they want EU primary residency, APAC warm-standby, 24-month term is preferred but want pricing for 12 vs 24, and 2x capacity uplift during market spikes. Risks/needs: KMS mapping (customer-managed KMS preferred), SOC2 evidence package, and a clear failover SLA.

Questions for pricing model (please reply all):
- Aditya: compute baseline — current committed QPS is ~40k tokens/min. They want 2x committed burst for campaign windows. Give both hosted + dedicated pricing vs just hosted with reserved burst.
- Lauren: include updated T&Cs for residency (data at rest in EU, backups mirrored to APAC warm-standby but marked as failover-only). We need a short clause for test failovers and a runbook attachment.
- Dylan: confirm audit log retention (24 months) and how we deliver logs (S3 replication vs secure push). Also confirm encryption in transit standards and whether we can support customer KMS.

I’ve attached a redline spreadsheet for pricing primes. Please get estimates by EOD Mon so I can share a draft with Maya on Tue morning.

Thanks,
Kimberly

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal + EU residency + APAC warm-standby — pricing & SOW ask

Kim / team — quick numbers to use in the draft: 
- Option A (Hosted + Reserved Burst): 12-month: baseline commit 40k tokens/min + 2x burst entitlement = +18% ARR; 24-month: same config = +12% ARR (volume discount).
- Option B (Dedicated Pool): 12-month: Dedicated 2-GPU pool for EU primary with APAC warm-standby (replicated snapshot-based warm nodes) = +34% ARR; 24-month = +25% ARR (applies when customer pays commit for 24 months). Dedicated gives stronger latency guarantees and intra-region throughput headroom.

Operational notes: KMS — we can support customer-managed KMS in EU (bring-your-own-key). Audit logs: we will deliver daily compressed audit bundles to a pre-provisioned S3 bucket (EU region) with optional cross-region replication to APAC standby on customer request. Failover SLA — recommend RTO target 60 minutes for warm-standby with a documented test window once per quarter.

I’ll prepare sample pricing rows for the spreadsheet and upload to the HubSpot deal. DocuSign link will be ready once legal okays the residency clause.

— Aditya
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Renewal + EU residency + APAC warm-standby

Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft pricing. We’re happy to proceed on a 24-month term under Option B (Dedicated Pool) provided we get the following in the SOW:
- EU primary compute and storage for EEA traffic; APAC warm-standby with replication snapshots only (no processing until failover).
- Customer-managed KMS support and KMS key rotation window documented in the runbook.
- Quarterly failover test windows and a 60-minute RTO target (we understand reduced RPO during the test).
- 24-month log retention and daily secure bundle delivery to our EU S3 bucket.

If you can provide a final SOW + a DocuSign-ready contract with those clauses, we’ll sign and schedule a technical kickoff for the week after the contract is countersigned.

Regards,
Maya Singh
Head of Ops, NovaLabs
